text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I am a knight.
No matter who my opponent is—I shall feel no fear.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(There is nothing this "Holy Sword" cannot cut!
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Insolent fool. Struggle all you like, Umamusume.
No matter how many times you slash at me with those legs—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"My mana cannot be depleted. My spiritual power is limitless.
Limitless enough to reshape this mortal realm
into a realm of darkness!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(For this one... I just don't know.
The opponent is a fallen angel who even trampled the Classic Triple Crown.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I might suffer a miserable defeat.
I might be crushed and left lying face down on the battlefield...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I—am—
choice_data_list: Durandal! You can do it, absolutely!
Durandal! You can totally do it, I know you can!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My King...
choice_data_list: They're strong, but at this distance, we've got a chance!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that is true...
Even if she's superior at medium distance,
we have the home turf advantage at the mile.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if we end up taking each other down—
I shall deliver a blow with every ounce of my being.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed. This is a battle I cannot concede.
All to spread the renown of my Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(To make everyone acknowledge her as the King at all costs.
That is my one and only wish.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (I can't just fall without putting on a show! I will see the dawn of our nation!)
(WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Tanino Gimlet-san...
Her presence really is... on another level...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, so you've come—rotted sword of lamentation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I swore an oath. Once a month!
I will seize the holy grail and smash it into the earth."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The banquet of the Fifth Month is—right here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You are the sacrifice, and I am the devourer.
Now, let our eve of the Tokyo Yushun begin.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(So you truly intend to run
in the Japanese Derby...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Showing up in a Mile GⅠ just to prove a point...
She truly is a monster...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Can she really... finish it
with just her late burst!?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If a final burst alone won't cut it,
I should check them early—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!? My King, that is correct...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I must not forget the dignity of a knight.
Do not rush for glory; maintain a steady stance.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(That is the command of my King.
And――)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(What Princess Fine taught me
through our duel...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Repaying the kindness of those who helped me—now is the time!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Prepare yourself!
Tanino Gimlet, demigod of pitch black!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable you may be,
I shall not fear. This NHK Mile Cup is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The sanctuary of sprint Umamusume!
Return to where you belong, to the Classic Triple Crown!
(Oooooh)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, of course I'll return. But only after conquering
this mile and claiming one of the twin rings for my arm!

"Neither Durandal nor Tanino Gimlet
backed down an inch, trading theatrical declarations."

The greatest showdown of the Spring Classics.
When it's over, who will be left standing on the battlefield—
the Holy, or the Demonic?
